methods.literal_replay: Read producer scripts as inert AST, extract explicit manually declared tables and metadata/note literals, and expand them using separately authored code. Resolve only whitelisted data expressions; no arbitrary AST execution, eval or exec. No reader/comparator producer is imported or executed. Full reconstructed JSON objects, not samples or selected fields, must match every saved reader and comparison.
methods.validation: Check source-specific region, pair, reader role, source image, boxes and dependency pins; exact target coverage; declared raw-reading block coverage; integer bounds; sorted disjoint core/fringe; membership IDs and unions; selected-cell boundary flags; nonempty notes; status semantics; genuine same-column unresolved-band references; partition across models and unresolved material; and missing versus explicit-empty records.
methods.arithmetic: For every route and all-ink column, independently use membership truth tables across the integer row range to derive intersection, union, primary-only, peer-only and symmetric difference for core, fringe and outer classes. Reconstruct and compare every summary and metadata field. Primary and peer roles are explicit, independent of dictionary insertion order.
methods.source_check: Fresh Pillow decoding of both unchanged 741-by-88 RGB JPEG sources; every row-major context coordinate and RGB byte checked. Diagnose selected exact-white cells without editing selections. Context, reader and comparison repeat files must be byte-identical. Every dependency and all 37 preserved energy89 pins checked before and after replay.
